items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Glenn Miller didn't have nothing to do with it. Glenn didn't. I mean that's what the public thinks.

ctx.x: In the 30's. We were working out with Lou Armstrong. We were working down in the Cotton Club when that happened - '39.

He wasn't involved in other things - I remember now, Leeds used to put out band arrangements. Like 'String of Pearls' and stuff like that by Glenn Miller and so forth. Did Glenn Miller get his stuff from Fletcher Henderson? A lot of people said that Glenn Miller was just a bigger orchestration of Fletcher Henderson.
The only thing that made Glenn Miller popular is Joe Garland when he wrote 'In the Mood.'
